name: the beach
title: A Grey Beach
description: Wet sand, broken shells, a line of wrack.
_arrive: what you see each time you come back: every line whose 'when' holds, in order

text: Back on the sand. The wind finds you at once.
The beach again: wet sand, a line of wrack.

arrive.text: The beach in the dark. Only the surf, and a pale line of foam.
Smoke rises from the ring of rocks.
The ring of rocks waits, cold.
Shells on the stone under the cliff.

explore.name: look around
nothingLog: You walk the shore again. Nothing new.

text: Grey sand runs both ways until it bends out of sight. Wrack and broken shells mark the tide line.
Behind the dunes the trees begin. A forest, close and hard to miss.
At the far end of the beach, a ring of rocks breaks the sea wind.
You could light a fire here, if you find some wood.
Past the rocks, a low cliff drops into the surf. Shells cling to the wet stone below it.
You could pick them and eat them as they are. Cooked, they would go further.
In the shallows, a school of small fish turns and flashes.
Too quick for bare hands. With a sharp stick you might spear one.

activities.name: light fire
activities.log: A spark, a curl of smoke. The fire takes.

activities.name: collect shells
log: You prise shells off the wet stone. The surf soaks your legs.
A handful of shells, cold and heavy.

activities.name: catch fish

outcomes.text: Two fish, flapping on the sand.
Nothing. The fish are quicker than you.

activities.log: You wade into the shallows, spear raised.

activities.name: sleep
activities.requiresText: Too cold and dark to sleep without a fire

outcomes.text: You wake in the dark. The surf is loud.

activities._thoughts: before sleeping: how tired you are (energy, same bands as the bar), then up to 3 things you remember from today, most memorable first

lines.text: You drop by the fire, too exhausted to feel the cold sand.
You curl up by the fire. Every muscle aches.
You curl up by the fire, tired in a slow, heavy way.
You lie by the fire, not really tired. Sleep is slow to come.

intro: The day comes back to you in pieces.
Lying still, you go over the day.

lines.text: The cold sea. Waking alone on the sand.
The spear, straight and sharp, made with your own hands.
Fish flashing in the shallows, just out of reach.
Standing in the surf with the spear raised.
The first spark catching. Smoke, then warmth.
Cold water from a spring between mossy stones.
A ring of rocks, out of the wind.
The cool dark under the trees.
The smell of food over the fire.
Armful after armful of dry branches.
Shells pried from the wet stone.
Something in your stomach, at least.

otherwise: A day of small things. You hardly remember it.
